clean_and_validate_single_sequence: clean and validate a single amino acid protein sequence string against standard residue types
clean_and_validate_input_sequences: clean and validate a list of amino acid protein sequences with min and max length checks
merge_chunked_msa: merge chunked MSA database search results from Stockholm and tblout files sorted by E-value
show_msa_info: display a plot of per-residue non-gap amino acid counts from a deduplicated MSA
empty_placeholder_template_features: create zero-filled placeholder template feature arrays for a given number of templates and residues
